scenarios.description: real OpenTUI 0.5.3 threaded renderer with a changing frame and three stdout/marker routes

probeEventsPerFrame.reason: The marker-route benchmark isolates renderer routing, not Probe IR observation.

bytesPerFrame.reason: bytesSeenInJs contains terminal render bytes and markers, not semantic-channel bytes.

fullSnapshots.reason: The marker-route benchmark deliberately has no semantic driver.

deltas.reason: The marker-route benchmark deliberately has no semantic driver.

droppedEvents.reason: No semantic producer queue is active in this route-isolation benchmark.

coalescedEvents.reason: OpenTUI does not expose skipped native renders as a counter here.

semanticNodesPerFrame.reason: No semantic snapshot is built in this route-isolation benchmark.

unknownFrameworkNodesPerFrame.reason: No semantic snapshot is built in this route-isolation benchmark.

renderCorrelationRate.note: Marker writes divided by rendered frames; every sampled first marker was structurally after frame bytes.

probeSerializationTime.reason: No semantic snapshot is serialized in this route-isolation benchmark.

probeHotPathTime.reason: The benchmark reports renderer throughput rather than isolating a per-frame CPU duration.

applicationOverheadRatio.note: Native/feed throughput ratio; 1.0 means equal. Feed-only routing was 199 fps versus 201 native fps.

caveats: Each arm ran 3 times for 1000 ms with useThread=true and a changing frame.
This isolates native frame routing and marker placement; semantic payload cost is measured by semantic-pipeline.json.
